title: Hold an exploration licence
what: Hold an exploration licence (or other mining authorisation) from the state before prospecting or exploring for minerals.

sources.title: Mining Act 1978 (WA)
sources.quote: 155. Offence of mining without authority (1) Subject to subsection (2) a person shall not carry on mining on any land unless he is duly authorised under this or any other Act to do so.

sources.title: Mining Act 1978 (WA)
